overview.about: The RSM Classic closes the PGA Tour's autumn stretch at the Sea Island Resort in Georgia, using two of the resort's courses. A coastal test on the Seaside and Plantation layouts, it is often the last chance for players to secure their status for the season ahead.
overview.nextEvent: The next RSM Classic is played across Sea Island's courses in St. Simons Island, Georgia. The coastal Seaside layout, exposed to the wind, hosts the decisive rounds.
